split_protocol.normal_outer_rule: each of 4 N independent files is outer-test exactly once
split_protocol.fault_outer_rule: class-wise seeded permutation then np.array_split into 4 near-equal outer-test groups
split_protocol.normal_inner_rule: the 3 non-test N files are each validation once
split_protocol.fault_inner_rule: within each outer-train class, class-wise seeded permutation then np.array_split into 3 validation groups
split_protocol.window_unit: inherits group; cannot split across partitions

evaluation.file_aggregation: mean predicted probabilities across windows -> argmax
evaluation.outer_summary: 4 fold values + median + min-max; not confidence interval

learned_steps: optional median imputer if training data requires it
optional median imputer if training data requires it

weighting.base_file_balance: each training file contributes equal total window weight: 1 / number_of_training_windows_in_that_file
weighting.optional_class_balance: multiply by inverse training-file count of the class; compute from training groups only; normalize mean training weight to 1

selection_rule.score: mean inner-validation file-level Macro-F1 across the 3 inner folds of the current outer fold
selection_rule.tie_break_1: higher minimum per-class file recall averaged across inner folds
selection_rule.tie_break_2: simpler model/configuration in fixed order LR before RF, lower complexity before higher
selection_rule.outer_test_use: one-time evaluation after inner selection and refit on all outer-train groups

failure_standards: any outer test or inner validation missing OR/IR/B/N
any preprocessing object fit using validation/test groups
candidate fails or times out in more than 25% of required inner folds
file-level probability aggregation unavailable or non-finite
outer test consulted before candidate/hyperparameters frozen
